# UITextboxComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Single-line text field of a script UI with an optional length limit; the callback gets the text whenever it changes.

## Methods

### text {#text}

::: member

Replaces the text without calling the callback.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | new text; longer text is cut to the length limit |

**Returns** [`UITextboxComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextboxComponent) — this text field

:::

### color {#color}

::: member

Sets the text color.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xRRGGBB` |

**Returns** [`UITextboxComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextboxComponent) — this text field

:::

### border {#border}

::: member

Shows or hides the border and the dark background.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `border` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether they are drawn |

**Returns** [`UITextboxComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UITextboxComponent) — this text field

:::
